visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A String Is Thrown Instead of an Error
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The handler should print Caught: Not a number: abc, but it prints Caught: undefined.

solution.explanation: JavaScript lets you throw any value, but only Error objects have a message property. Here the caught value is a plain string, so e.message is undefined. Always throw new Error(...) so the message and a stack trace are available.
